table_title: List the countries that adopted the euro from 1999 through 2023, including their adoption year.
db_analog: SELECT country, adoption_year FROM eurozone_accessions WHERE adoption_year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2023 ORDER BY adoption_year, country
temporal_note: Wikipedia page accessed on 2026-04-23. The cited source explicitly states that the first 11 eurozone members introduced the euro on 1 January 1999 and then lists the later entrants: Greece in 2001, Slovenia (2007), Cyprus and Malta (2008), Slovakia (2009), Estonia (2011), Latvia (2014), Lithuania (2015), Croatia (2023), and Bulgaria (2026). This instance intentionally filters that historical accession list to the 1999-2023 range, excluding only Bulgaria 2026.
_extraction_notes: Built from the historical-enlargements summary on the Wikipedia page 'Enlargement of the eurozone'. The page explicitly identifies the first 11 eurozone members as adopting the euro in 1999, then lists Greece joining in 2001 and the subsequent entrants through Bulgaria in 2026. This staged instance takes that explicit accession list and applies a closed historical filter of 1999 through 2023, producing the twenty countries in that range.
